title: Chain2Moon
tagline: Chain2Moon: A Web3 gaming platform where players mint NFTs to join prediction rounds, stake crypto, and make daily binary choices. Compete, earn points, and grow your stakes based on your prediction accuracy. Trust your gut, stake your claim! 🎮🔮
description:
https://youtu.be/E2wWjmy82L8

Chain2Moon is a decentralized gaming platform that combines the excitement of prediction markets with NFT ownership and crypto staking mechanics. At its core, the platform challenges players to trust their intuition while competing for rewards in a transparent, blockchain-based environment.
The journey begins with players minting their unique Entry NFT, which serves as both their access token and performance record. These NFTs are more than just digital collectibles – they're the player's digital identity within the ecosystem, recording their prediction history and achievements. Each NFT could potentially carry unique attributes that provide special bonuses or advantages in the game.
Once players have their NFT, they enter the staking phase. Participants lock in their chosen amount of cryptocurrency through secure smart contracts. This creates a reward pool while ensuring player commitment to the game. The platform supports multiple stake tiers, allowing both casual players and serious competitors to participate at their comfort level.
The core gameplay revolves around daily binary predictions – simple yes/no decisions that test players' intuition. Each day, players must submit their prediction within a specified timeframe. The beauty of this system lies in its simplicity: players don't need complex analysis tools or deep market knowledge – they're rewarded for their natural intuition and consistency.

Points are calculated and stored on-chain based on multiple factors: prediction accuracy, participation streaks, stake amounts, and any NFT-based bonuses. This transparent scoring system ensures fair play and creates an engaging competitive environment. All predictions, results, and point calculations are immutably recorded on the blockchain, providing complete transparency and eliminating any possibility of manipulation.

At the end of each game round, players face a strategic choice: they can either claim their rewards based on their performance or compound their earnings by rolling them into the next round. This create-and-grow mechanism encourages long-term participation and strategic thinking. High performers can continuously grow their stakes, while the platform maintains sustained engagement through consecutive gaming rounds
how_its_made:
We built our platform utilizing several key sponsor technologies to enhance functionality and user experience. Worldcoin's Protocol SDK was integrated for robust identity verification, ensuring one-person-one-account and preventing gaming of the system. 
Web3Auth implementation provides seamless onboarding for new users through social logins, significantly lowering entry barriers for crypto newcomers.
For financial stability and security, we leveraged Circle's infrastructure to handle stablecoin transactions, enabling reliable stake management and reward distributions. This ensures users have a consistent value reference point throughout their gameplay periods.
The visual identity of our platform is enhanced through Nouns DAO's component library, which we use to generate unique, dynamic NFT avatars for players. These avatars evolve based on player performance and achievements, creating a more engaging user experience.
Our multi-chain deployment strategy ensures broad accessibility and reduced gas costs, with the platform operating seamlessly across Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Base networks. This cross-chain functionality is managed through custom bridge contracts and unified messaging systems, allowing players to interact with the platform on their preferred network while maintaining a consistent experience.
